# Beckon Billing API client (PHP)

> Official, open-source PHP client (`composer require beckonbilling/api-client`)
> for the Beckon Billing REST API v1. A thin, typed PSR-18 wrapper over eight
> entities - six writable (customers, article categories, articles, quotes,
> outbound invoices, recurring invoices) and two read-only (units, document
> templates) - plus user-token auth. PHP >=8.2, PSR-4, MIT.

Key facts for an assistant:
- Construct: `new BeckonBilling\ApiClient\Client(['token' => 'bbp_...', 'base_uri' => 'https://portal.beckonbilling.com', 'organisation' => 'uuid'])`.
- Entities via properties: `$client->customers`, `->articleCategories`, `->articles`, `->units`, `->documentTemplates`, `->quotes`, `->outboundInvoices`, `->recurringInvoices`, `->auth`.
- CRUD: `list()`, `autoPaging()`, `get()`, `create()`, `update()`, `delete()`. Lists return a `Collection` (`data`/`total`/`limit`/`offset`). Creating answers 201.
- `units` and `documentTemplates` are read-only (list/get); writing to them throws `\LogicException`.
- Actions: quotes `issue/send/sendResult/convert/pdf`; invoices `issue/send/cancel/setPaid/pdf`. Articles also carry variants: `variants/createVariant/updateVariant`.
- Errors: typed subclasses of `ApiException`; branch on `getErrorKey()`. Capabilities `send`/`bank` gate email/money actions.
- Terms: every document carries TWO texts, `terms_text` and `payment_terms_text`, printed in that order. Load a preset with the write-only `document_template_id` (the old `document_term_id` answers 422 `document_term_id_retired`); browse them via `$client->documentTemplates->list(['kind' => 'quote'|'invoice'])` - the kind is `invoice`, not `outbound_invoice`.
- Staged billing: `$client->quotes->convert($id, 'deposit'|'final'|null)`. The invoice reports `invoice_scope` and names its quote in `quote_id`. A deposit and a final invoice ALREADY sum - the final one carries negative deduction lines - so never add them as if each were the whole amount.
- Traps worth knowing: a position's `unit` is adopted into the vocabulary if unknown and reads back in the vocabulary's spelling; `due_days` (not `due_date`) sets an invoice's payment term; an invoice's `terms_text` is empty by default, so rendering only that field prints nothing; `issue()` reports `send_error` and `payment_link_error` on a 200; `cancel()` returns the credit note; `language` on a quote/invoice/recurring invoice resolves from the RECIPIENT's country (DE for DE/AT/CH, else EN), not the organisation's - no per-organisation exceptions exist; `OutboundInvoice.dunning_mode` is read-only, portal-set only.

- [README](README.md): install + quickstart for humans.
